summary: Implemented bounded_task as a registered node executor that adapts the existing bounded standard-harness behavior to PlanIR nodes and runtime CapabilityGrants.

behavior.details: BoundedTaskExecutor.execute_task validates node_type=bounded_task, rejects terminal_goal_verification nodes, validates runtime grants against the plan id, node id, and executor role, and runs TaskHarness through the supplied node request.

CapabilityRuntimeProvider routes process.exec through LocalRuntimeGateway.run_command. TaskHarness policy evidence now checks changed files through LocalRuntimeGateway.authorize_write_path before accepting deterministic gates.
Deterministic checks remain the L0 gate. Semantic task review is invoked only when the node declares a review or semantic gate ref; otherwise semantic_review_skipped evidence is emitted.
Existing terminal failure preservation remains in TaskHarness. NodeExecutionResult includes terminalFailureRefs when the terminal-failure record exists.
standard-harness invocation now builds a one-node compatibility PlanIR and calls the same BoundedTaskExecutor service.

acceptance_coverage.coverage: bounded_task runs from NodeExecutionRequest(plan, node, capability_grants) instead of directly owning WorkflowRunRequest.
BoundedTaskExecutor rejects terminal Goal verification nodes and records taskCompletedStateUpdateAttempted=false.
Semantic review is controlled by node gate_refs; L0 deterministic gates still run before review.
Rejected, error, and blocked task outcomes preserve terminal-failure refs when produced by TaskHarness.
The compatibility adapter and native request both call the same executor implementation.

verification.summary: Covered existing bounded standard-harness failure, retry, invocation, and terminal failure behavior during focused validation

known_limitations: The standard-harness module id is intentionally retained as a temporary compatibility adapter until a later task authorizes removal.
The runtime gateway protects calls routed through it; it is not an OS sandbox for code that bypasses the gateway.
